labels.text: The Technical AdvisoryGroup (TAG)of the International ComparisonProgram (ICP) held anonlinemeeting
labels.rationale: Default: body text, list item, table cell, page number or other non-heading content on this page

labels.text: on April 30, 2024.
labels.rationale: Default: body text, list item, table cell, page number or other non-heading content on this page

labels.text: The main objectives of the meeting were to update the Group on the progress of the current ICP 2021
labels.rationale: Default: body text, list item, table cell, page number or other non-heading content on this page

labels.text: cycle, discuss the final results of the 2021 cycle, and the plans for the release of the results, as per the
labels.rationale: Default: body text, list item, table cell, page number or other non-heading content on this page

labels.text: meeting agenda provided in Annex 1. In attendance were the TAG Chair, members and observers,
labels.rationale: Default: body text, list item, table cell, page number or other non-heading content on this page

labels.text: representatives from the Regional Implementing Agencies (RIAs), and staff from the World Bank ICP
labels.rationale: Default: body text, list item, table cell, page number or other non-heading content on this page

labels.text: Global Office, which serves as TAG secretariat, and other World Bank staff, as listed in Annex 2. The public
labels.rationale: Default: body text, list item, table cell, page number or other non-heading content on this page

labels.text: meeting documents and presentations are available on the ICP website.
labels.rationale: Default: body text, list item, table cell, page number or other non-heading content on this page

labels.text: Paul Schreyer, TAG Chair, welcomed all participants and provided an overview of the agenda, including
labels.rationale: Default: body text, list item, table cell, page number or other non-heading content on this page

labels.text: the main ICP 2021 benchmark results and estimates for more recent years, revised ICP 2017 results, 2017-
labels.rationale: Default: body text, list item, table cell, page number or other non-heading content on this page

labels.text: 2021 time series, and non-benchmark country estimates. The Chair also highlighted the confidentiality of
labels.rationale: Default: body text, list item, table cell, page number or other non-heading content on this page

labels.text: all shared and presented results.
labels.rationale: Default: body text, list item, table cell, page number or other non-heading content on this page

labels.text: Session I: ICP 2021 cycle results
labels.rationale: Session heading "Session I: ICP 2021 cycle results" (bold 12)

labels.text: ICP 2021 results and forecasts
labels.rationale: Item heading "ICP 2021 results and forecasts" (bold 11)

labels.text: Marko Rissanen, World Bank, presented the ICP 2021 cycle results and PPP estimates for more recent
labels.rationale: Default: body text, list item, table cell, page number or other non-heading content on this page

labels.text: years. The presentation was divided into four parts: (i) general updates; (ii) data quality assurance and the
labels.rationale: Default: body text, list item, table cell, page number or other non-heading content on this page

labels.text: results of simulations discussed in previous TAG meetings, (iii) benchmark ICP 2021 global results; and (iv)
labels.rationale: Default: body text, list item, table cell, page number or other non-heading content on this page

labels.text: PPP estimates for 2022-2026 period.
labels.rationale: Default: body text, list item, table cell, page number or other non-heading content on this page

labels.text: On general updates, it was announced that Kosovo will be included as a benchmark country, based on
labels.rationale: Default: body text, list item, table cell, page number or other non-heading content on this page

labels.text: available Eurostat-OECD PPPs for householdconsumption: this increases the total number of participating
labels.rationale: Default: body text, list item, table cell, page number or other non-heading content on this page

labels.text: economies in the ICP 2021 cycle to 176. The outcomes of both the latest United Nations Statistical
labels.rationale: Default: body text, list item, table cell, page number or other non-heading content on this page

labels.text: Commission (UNSC) Session and the Governing Board meeting that took place after the previous TAG
labels.rationale: Default: body text, list item, table cell, page number or other non-heading content on this page

labels.text: meeting were also presented.
labels.rationale: Default: body text, list item, table cell, page number or other non-heading content on this page
Page number

labels.text: factors that impact the PPP revisions, namely, the national accounts expenditure revisions and their
labels.rationale: Default: body text, list item, table cell, page number or other non-heading content on this page

labels.text: impact on regional PPPs, population estimates revisions, the revision of Productivity Adjustment Factors
labels.rationale: Default: body text, list item, table cell, page number or other non-heading content on this page

labels.text: (PAFs), and the Asia and the Pacific hybrid approach to housing services.
labels.rationale: Default: body text, list item, table cell, page number or other non-heading content on this page

labels.text: Revised ICP 2017 – ICP 2021 PPP time series
labels.rationale: Item heading "Revised ICP 2017 – ICP 2021 PPP time series"

labels.text: Giovanni Tonutti, World Bank, presented the results of the time series calculations of global PPPs for the
labels.rationale: Default: body text, list item, table cell, page number or other non-heading content on this page

labels.text: years 2017 to 2021. The approach follows the methodology developed by Inklaar and Rao (2019), which
labels.rationale: Default: body text, list item, table cell, page number or other non-heading content on this page

labels.text: was adopted to estimate the global PPP time series for 2011 to 2017 during the ICP 2017 cycle. Two
labels.rationale: Default: body text, list item, table cell, page number or other non-heading content on this page

labels.text: methodological developments have been introduced and previously approved by the TAG in relation to
labels.rationale: Default: body text, list item, table cell, page number or other non-heading content on this page

labels.text: the new approach for linking the CIS region in the global comparison and the implications of the impact
labels.rationale: Default: body text, list item, table cell, page number or other non-heading content on this page

labels.text: of COVID-19 on expenditures for interpolating missing information.
labels.rationale: Default: body text, list item, table cell, page number or other non-heading content on this page

labels.text: Following these methodological considerations, results were presented with two approaches: (i)
labels.rationale: Default: body text, list item, table cell, page number or other non-heading content on this page

labels.text: comparing the extrapolated PPPs, currently available in the WDI database, with the estimation of
labels.rationale: Default: body text, list item, table cell, page number or other non-heading content on this page

labels.text: interpolated PPPs; and (ii) comparing the estimation of interpolated PPP from the basic heading level
labels.rationale: Default: body text, list item, table cell, page number or other non-heading content on this page

labels.text: (standard approach) to the interpolated PPPs at the GDP level only. At the aggregate level, the results
labels.rationale: Default: body text, list item, table cell, page number or other non-heading content on this page

labels.text: display similarities to the differences observed for the ICP 2011-2017 time series. At the country level,
labels.rationale: Default: body text, list item, table cell, page number or other non-heading content on this page

labels.text: while the PPP time series remains stable for most countries, there were selected cases where volatile
labels.rationale: Default: body text, list item, table cell, page number or other non-heading content on this page

labels.text: inflation, exchange rates, or both caused significant variations over the PPP time series as well. The impact
labels.rationale: Default: body text, list item, table cell, page number or other non-heading content on this page

labels.text: of changing the CIS linking approach was demonstrated to be small.
labels.rationale: Default: body text, list item, table cell, page number or other non-heading content on this page

labels.text: The TAG acknowledged the 2017 – 2021 time series results as plausible, yielding expected patterns and
labels.rationale: Default: body text, list item, table cell, page number or other non-heading content on this page

labels.text: results.
labels.rationale: Default: body text, list item, table cell, page number or other non-heading content on this page

labels.text: Furthermore, the revision of the 2012 – 2016 PPP series was raised in the discussion. Initially, these series
labels.rationale: Default: body text, list item, table cell, page number or other non-heading content on this page

labels.text: were not planned to be updated; however, since the 2017 benchmark PPPs were revised, a suggestion
labels.rationale: Default: body text, list item, table cell, page number or other non-heading content on this page

labels.text: was made to link the 2012 – 2016 series to the revised 2017 benchmark PPPs to ensure consistency of the
labels.rationale: Default: body text, list item, table cell, page number or other non-heading content on this page

labels.text: time series. The Global Office agreed to review the feasibility of revising the said historical series and
labels.rationale: Default: body text, list item, table cell, page number or other non-heading content on this page

labels.text: consult the TAG members as needed.
labels.rationale: Default: body text, list item, table cell, page number or other non-heading content on this page

labels.text: Revised ICP 2017 and ICP 2021 non-benchmark country estimates
labels.rationale: Item heading "Revised ICP 2017 and ICP 2021 non-benchmark country estimates"

labels.text: Mizuki Yamanaka, World Bank, presented the results of non-benchmark PPP estimates based on revised
labels.rationale: Default: body text, list item, table cell, page number or other non-heading content on this page

labels.text: 2017 and 2021 benchmark results. Firstly, the estimation methods were summarized, as follows: (i)
labels.rationale: Default: body text, list item, table cell, page number or other non-heading content on this page

labels.text: detailed time series estimate for countries that participated in either ICP 2017 or ICP 2021 cycle but not
labels.rationale: Default: body text, list item, table cell, page number or other non-heading content on this page

labels.text: for both; (ii) standard non-benchmark imputation for counties with no participation in any recent cycles;
labels.rationale: Default: body text, list item, table cell, page number or other non-heading content on this page

labels.text: (iii) estimation for countries that have limited participation for household consumption (HHC) only; and
labels.rationale: Default: body text, list item, table cell, page number or other non-heading content on this page

labels.text: (iv) extrapolation from ICP 2011 results for countries that participated in ICP 2011 only.
labels.rationale: Default: body text, list item, table cell, page number or other non-heading content on this page

labels.text: Following the summary of the estimation methods, a series of charts plotting the relation of GDP per
labels.rationale: Default: body text, list item, table cell, page number or other non-heading content on this page

labels.text: capita and price level for the non-benchmark countries, along with those of benchmark countries, were
labels.rationale: Default: body text, list item, table cell, page number or other non-heading content on this page

labels.text: presented for the GDP, HHC, and Actual Individual Consumption (AIC) levels to review if the estimated
labels.rationale: Default: body text, list item, table cell, page number or other non-heading content on this page

labels.text: results were plausible. It was summarized that, in general, imputation for GDP, AIC, and HHC are in line
labels.rationale: Default: body text, list item, table cell, page number or other non-heading content on this page

labels.text: with benchmark results as expected; however, it was also noted that the model returns unreliable results
labels.rationale: Default: body text, list item, table cell, page number or other non-heading content on this page

labels.text: for a few countries with a GDP per capita much higher or lower than any benchmark countries as they are
labels.rationale: Default: body text, list item, table cell, page number or other non-heading content on this page

labels.text: beyond the boundary of the model. Lastly, the non-benchmark time series estimates were deemed
labels.rationale: Default: body text, list item, table cell, page number or other non-heading content on this page

labels.text: plausible; however, a few cases require further review of input data for some components.
labels.rationale: Default: body text, list item, table cell, page number or other non-heading content on this page
Page number

labels.text: The TAG acknowledgedthedifficulty ofestimation for some cases presentedand agreed to omitestimates
labels.rationale: Default: body text, list item, table cell, page number or other non-heading content on this page

labels.text: for the cases where available input data returns extreme results, as the imputation would not be able to
labels.rationale: Default: body text, list item, table cell, page number or other non-heading content on this page

labels.text: fit them in the model in a reliable manner, or when the reliability of input data was questionable. The TAG
labels.rationale: Default: body text, list item, table cell, page number or other non-heading content on this page

labels.text: also recommended conducting a further review of input data for the few limited cases for detailed time
labels.rationale: Default: body text, list item, table cell, page number or other non-heading content on this page

labels.text: series estimates to ensure the plausibility of results. Regarding the countries with limited participation,
labels.rationale: Default: body text, list item, table cell, page number or other non-heading content on this page

labels.text: Eurostat suggested including Kosovo’s HHC-level data without any estimation beyond 2021. The TAG also
labels.rationale: Default: body text, list item, table cell, page number or other non-heading content on this page

labels.text: stressed the importance of having metadata to clarify the limitation of non-benchmark estimation, as
labels.rationale: Default: body text, list item, table cell, page number or other non-heading content on this page

labels.text: these results were approximations with less reliability than benchmark results.
labels.rationale: Default: body text, list item, table cell, page number or other non-heading content on this page
